MATCH (tank:Tank {tag: 'T4750'})
MATCH (upstream)-[:send_to*1..]->(tank)
UNWIND nodes((upstream)-[:send_to*1..]->(tank)) AS item
WITH DISTINCT item
WHERE (item:BallValve OR item:GlobeValve OR item:ButterflyValve OR item:OperatedValve)
  AND NOT item:CheckValve
  AND NOT item:SafetyValveOrFitting
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH ()-[:control]->(item) }
  AND item.tag IS NOT NULL
RETURN item.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag

MATCH p=(u:PlantItem)-[:send_to*1..]->(t:Tank {tag: 'T4750'})

WITH DISTINCT n
WHERE n.tag IS NOT NULL

    'OperatedValve', 'BallValve', 'GlobeValve', 'ButterflyValve',
    'CheckValve', 'SafetyValveOrFitting', 'SpringLoadedGlobeSafetyValve'
  ])
RETURN n.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag
